newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita says to show DVD player on Aug 29th.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita says to show DVD player on Aug 29th.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co said on Tuesday that it would reveal its DVD player, to be launched in Japan this autumn, on August 29.
Matsushita is expected to announce the selling price and the launch date in Japan of the player at the news conference.

A Matsushita spokesman said product design has been completed except for a copyguard system, on which U.S. film makers and hardware makers have not yet agreed. Because of a delay in agreement on the system, there has been talk that the player's launch will be delayed into next year.
